name: Đầu ghi hình Hikvision DS-7204HTHI-K1 4K H265+ TURBO HD DVR
summary: Video Input and Transmission  Self-adaptive HDTVI/HDCVI/AHD/CVBS signal input  Up to 2-ch 8 MP IP cameras input  8 MP HDTVI video input and live view  Defogging function enabled for the supported analog cameras  Long distance transmission over UTP and coaxial cable: max.
